_comment: The versions of the moving parts this skill was last checked against: every script's selftest green,
and the browser drivers run against a real tenant (canvas-browser.mjs walk and publish on a published
canvas app; site-walk.mjs selftest, both halves, on Chrome). The monthly upkeep workflow
(.github/workflows/upkeep.yml) compares the npm entries with the registry and opens an issue when
they move. After re-verifying, update the versions here and set checkedWith to the released version.
npm: packages the scripts load. runtimes and tools: what the machine ran. Earlier versions may work
but are not checked; the engines floor in package.json (Node 20) still applies.

tools.browser: Chrome (channel chrome) on Windows 11; Chromium in CI
